name: DDC handleDeductFee missing access control
summary: DDC's handleDeductFee(uint256,uint256,address,address) was callable by anyone and moved the fee amount out of an arbitrary holder, so the attacker deducted the whole DDC/USDT pair balance to themselves and sold it.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/ddc-token.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: DDC 0x443195AA3a4357242a7427Fc8ce5f20c1E71fcB1 created 2022-08-28T13:29:14Z by 0x1a8def16f2b9a69743fb301f82bd61ddfa65f7f6, unrelated to attack sender 0x5b69f9c6cbb4958008eae46072886e6b9524fdef; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment (the token was less than two hours old).
